youtube_short.title: Your Losing Fund Still Got You a $1,842 Tax Bill
title_alternatives: Mutual Funds Tax You Even When They Lose Money
The IRS Bill From a Fund That Lost 18%
youtube_short.description: Your mutual fund lost money last year — and the IRS still sent you a bill. It's called phantom income, and 80% of fund investors are paying it without knowing. In 2022, funds lost 18% but still distributed $1.3 trillion in capital gains. The fix is simple: switch taxable accounts to low-cost ETFs and stop paying taxes on money you never got. Check box 2a on your 1099-DIV — that number is costing you. #mutualfunds #ETF #investing #taxes #personalfinance

hook_line: Your fund LOST money. The IRS wants $1,842 anyway.
